name: What are the different types of anode rods available, and which is best?

mainEntity.name: What are the different types of anode rods available, and which is best?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are primarily three types of anode rods: magnesium, aluminum, and aluminum/zinc alloy. Magnesium rods are generally considered effective for most water conditions. Aluminum rods are often used in areas with very hard water or when a sulfur smell is present, as they can sometimes help reduce it. Aluminum/zinc rods are specifically designed to combat 'rotten egg' odors. The best choice depends on your water heater's material and your local water quality, which a professional can help determine. For example, if you're experiencing a sulfur smell, an aluminum/zinc rod might be recommended by our plumbers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Anode rods come in magnesium, aluminum, and aluminum/zinc; the best type depends on your water quality and if you're experiencing issues like a sulfur smell.
